decision: Bind the exact replacement H200 identity and require one durable cold-bootstrap owner seam before opening a claim. The unchanged R5 candidate-only science remains selected and unconsumed.

immutable_science.quality_oracle: Exact byte-for-byte equality of each matched request's ordered emitted choice.text chunks, finish fields, SSE-event count, and usage accounting against the immutable stock oracle; ignore only transport-volatile IDs and timestamps.

requirements: The launcher must consume the exact current bench record, atomically claim only that bench, derive a claim-generation-bound execution envelope, and start a controller-host detached owner with a fresh runtime ready-file.
The outer owner must heartbeat the continuous claim across cold bootstrap, endpoint execution, repair generations, terminal retrieval, and generation-fenced release.

The owner must reconcile the exact target, draft, runtime image, packet, oracle, and workload by content-addressed manifest. Transfer only missing or mismatched immutable files to temporary names, verify them, and atomically finalize them.

The owner must use the registered resource host, user, identity path, and known-hosts namespace, and the verified H200 UUID and SSH fingerprint from the current bench contents. It must fail closed on any identity change.
After immutable staging is durable, the same owner must continue directly into the existing R5 candidate-only runner. A staging-only terminal or release is forbidden.

Recoverable import, path, permission, Docker, runtime API, model-load, server-readiness, request-contract, retrieval, or classification defects must remain inside the same heartbeating multi-generation dispatcher while a measured restart still fits.

A decision-bearing exact endpoint terminal may release ready; an unsafe or unreachable guest or the absolute deadline releases maintenance. Unknown, incomplete, or pre-science results retain repair ownership.
The implementation may reuse shared lab workspace, endpoint, repair-handshake, detached-owner, and manifest tooling. It must not invent provider lifecycle control.

validation_contract.scope: local deterministic controller and manifest behavior only
must_prove: temporary-name plus verify plus atomic-finalize semantics
claim exception paths preserve heartbeat ownership
exact project-relative launcher invocation and ready-file contract
all final source, packet, validation, and launcher hashes are bound
must_not_do: pull or launch the runtime image

lifecycle.reason: The remaining lifecycle must cover resumable cold staging, model startup, one retained integration repair, at most 32 candidate requests, terminal/release, and watchdog handoff margin.

publication_order: Finish and validate the cold owner, launcher, manifest contract, and any packet rebind.
Compute final hashes and atomically publish R5_COLD_BOOTSTRAP_OWNER_VALIDATION.json.
Publish R5_COLD_BOOTSTRAP_READY.json last with claim_allowed false.
Atomically update STATUS.json to a paused claim-disallowed director handoff; do not edit bound bytes afterward.
next_director_decision: After R5_COLD_BOOTSTRAP_READY.json is durable, re-read the exact bench, watchdog, and remaining lifecycle once. Open a fresh claim clock only if the cold staging, one retained repair, endpoint, terminal, release, and watchdog handoff still fit.
